**Finding: compliant (rule not engaged).**

Article XIII contains no auto-renewal mechanic. Section 13.1 provides a single term running on a Product-by-Product, country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term expires, at which point the Agreement expires and Ono's licenses convert to perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid-up, royalty-free licenses. Section 14.4 ("No Renewal, Extension or Waiver") expressly negates any implied renewal or extension from post-expiry dealing, and Section 13.2 gives Ono a without-cause termination right on notice.

There is accordingly no automatic renewal term, no non-renewal notice window to shorten, and no renewal price-uplift language to cap — the exit-ease and price-predictability risks this rule targets do not arise, and the structure is at least as favourable to us as the preferred position. No redline proposed.
